adoption.rationale: The pinned source documents Markdown injection escaping, but the third-party YARA description path captures the tool name, interpolates it into Behavior.Description, and adds that raw description to the Markdown table without calling sanitizeMarkdown. A full YARA-X-to-report.Generate-to-Markdown replay reproduces a raw HTTPS Markdown link and table delimiter. This contract is limited to the concrete witness and Markdown structure; downstream consumer impact remains unconfirmed.

contract.declared_domain: Counterexample domain: the single one-line ASCII YARA description witness recorded in product-replay.json. It matches the pinned Go RE2 search expression, is transformed by mungeDescription, and is rendered by the exact pinned report.Generate and Markdown renderer with YARA-X 1.19.0. This is a concrete witness only; it does not prove safety or exploitability for other descriptions or downstream Markdown viewers.
contract.guarantee: Third-party YARA description metadata matched by threatHuntingKeywordRe must not emit raw Markdown link syntax or an unescaped table-column delimiter in the generated Markdown report.
contract.input_source: The description metadata value from an operator-enabled third-party YARA rule, read by Malcontent's RuleFS and passed through mungeDescription into a report behavior.

domain: One-line ASCII third-party YARA description metadata accepted by the pinned threatHuntingKeywordRe; the frozen concrete witness must not create a raw Markdown link or table delimiter in the Markdown report.
